name: Sandro
origin: Evelyne Chetrite, Paris, 1984; menswear by her son Ilan from 2008.
opview: Positions itself as effortless Parisian sharpness.

onething.n: own-site search, not opened from this environment. Sandro Homme has been read as Parisian rock-and-roll since it launched in 2008, and the jacket is the piece that is theirs rather than a category anyone sells. The house currently pushes a varsity cut of the same idea

notes.fren: The accessible French silhouette at scale — narrow, dark, unfussy. It exports a specific Parisian idea rather than a house history.

cities: 15 own boutiques — the 45 on record counted 37 Bloomingdale's and Saks concessions
